C1224.title: Ctrip 'Big Data Price Discrimination'? No! Ruled as Consumer Fraud
C1224.summary: The Shaoxing Intermediate People's Court in Zhejiang Province issued a final judgment determining that Ctrip did not constitute 'big data price discrimination', but its conduct still amounted to consumer fraud, requiring compensation to the consumer. This case provides a reference for delineating the boundary between big data price discrimination and consumer fraud.
